detail.longDescription: I need to read the list of connections and their live status (running, stopped, queue depth) from Corepoint Integration Engine 7.5.3 via the Administration REST API into an external inventory tool. I do not currently have licensed vendor documentation nor access to a live, running server instance to inspect network traffic or run discovery, so I’m trying to establish the specification for our implementation plan ahead of time. What I have researched Documentation Access: Vendor walkthroughs (e.g., Administration API Walkthrough) and the official 7.5.3 release notes are locked behind a customer login portal which I do not have credentials for. Public Ecosystem: Public searches, case studies, and code repositories (including PowerShell automation examples) mention using the API but omit base endpoint paths, headers, and payload shapes. Namespace Verification: I found circulating endpoint patterns such as /api/v1/status and /api/v1/connections. Cross-referencing shows these belong to the Rhapsody engine namespace (a different product) rather than Corepoint. My questions What is the standard default Base URL / port configuration and authentication scheme (e.g., Basic, Bearer token, API key) used by the Corepoint 7.5.3 Administration API? What are the specific endpoint paths to query the connections list and connection status/queue metrics? If the API specification is restricted to licensed documentation, where in a local Corepoint installation or Admin GUI can an administrator locate or enable a Swagger/OpenAPI specification file? Notes and constraints I can only accept guidance that does not require vendor-licensed documentation to reproduce. If the exact information is vendor-restricted, please indicate where (filesystem path or GUI setting) an administrator can discover the OpenAPI/Swagger file on an installed engine.
